obligations.title: Maintain an independent risk management function
obligations.description: Maintain an independent risk management function reviewing and reporting risk management practices to the Board and Trustees.

obligations.title: Quarterly Board and Trustee risk reporting
obligations.description: Present the risk register, escalation log and risk posture to the Board and Trustees quarterly; report to SEBI on the mandated cadence.

obligations.title: Maintain a documented Business Contingency / DR plan
obligations.description: Maintain and periodically test a documented disaster recovery and business contingency plan covering mission-critical systems.

obligations.title: Accurate and timely NAV computation and publication
obligations.description: Compute and publish scheme NAVs accurately within prescribed timelines; report and compensate NAV errors per SEBI norms.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Investment restriction and exposure limit compliance
obligations.description: Comply with single-issuer, sector, and group exposure limits and scheme-level investment restrictions.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Timely settlement and reconciliation of scheme transactions
obligations.description: Settle scheme transactions within market timelines and maintain daily reconciliation with custodian and fund accountant.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Code of conduct and personal trading compliance
obligations.description: Enforce the employee code of conduct including personal trading pre-clearance, restricted lists and insider trading prevention.
obligations.citation: Fifth Schedule; SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations 2015

obligations.title: Advertising code compliance for scheme communications
obligations.description: Ensure all advertisements and investor communications comply with the SEBI advertising code, including mandated risk disclosures.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Investor grievance redressal within SCORES timelines
obligations.description: Resolve investor complaints within SEBI SCORES timelines and report ageing to the Board.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Cyber security and cyber resilience framework compliance
obligations.description: Implement the SEBI Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework including governance, protection, detection, response and recovery capabilities, with periodic VAPT and reporting.
obligations.framework: SEBI Cyber Security & Cyber Resilience Framework

obligations.title: Annual system audit by CISA/CISM qualified auditor
obligations.description: Conduct the annual systems audit per the SEBI System Audit Program checklist and file findings with rectification timelines.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Half-yearly trustee report filing
obligations.description: File the half-yearly trustee report with SEBI covering scheme compliance, risk and governance matters.

obligations.title: Outsourcing oversight of RTA, custodian and fund accountant
obligations.description: Maintain due diligence, SLAs and periodic service reviews over material outsourced service providers.
obligations.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds

obligations.title: Digital personal data protection readiness
obligations.description: Establish consent, purpose limitation, breach notification and data principal rights handling for investor personal data under the DPDP Act.

regulatoryChanges.title: Amendment to mutual fund expense ratio disclosure norms
regulatoryChanges.description: SEBI consultation-turned-circular revising TER disclosure granularity in scheme documents and factsheets, effective October 2026.
regulatoryChanges.framework: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds
regulatoryChanges.impactSummary: Requires factsheet template changes, updated SID disclosures and a one-time investor communication; obligation OBL-2026-0004 amended.

regulatoryChanges.title: CERT-In incident reporting timeline directions
regulatoryChanges.description: CERT-In directions mandating 6-hour reporting of specified cyber incidents and 180-day log retention for regulated entities.
regulatoryChanges.impactSummary: Incident response runbooks updated with 6-hour reporting step; log retention extended; new obligation link to cyber framework obligation.

regulatoryChanges.title: DPDP Act rules notification for data fiduciaries
regulatoryChanges.description: Notification of DPDP Rules operationalizing consent managers, breach notification format and significant data fiduciary criteria.
regulatoryChanges.impactSummary: Assessment in progress — likely new obligations for consent tooling, breach notification and privacy notices across investor channels.

complianceAssessments.title: Q2 cyber framework compliance assessment
complianceAssessments.rationale: VAPT completed and governance structures operating; patch SLA breaches (CEX-2026-0001) and incomplete MFA coverage prevent full compliance.

complianceAssessments.title: H1 NAV accuracy assessment
complianceAssessments.rationale: No NAV errors above threshold in H1; April recomputation cluster resolved with tolerance-check patch and did not breach investor compensation triggers.

complianceAssessments.title: DR plan currency and test evidence review
complianceAssessments.rationale: DR plan documented and tested, but the May failover exceeded RTO for the order management system (CEX-2026-0004); rated partially compliant until re-test passes.

complianceAssessments.title: DPDP readiness gap assessment
complianceAssessments.rationale: No consent management tooling, breach notification runbook or data principal rights workflow exists yet; remediation programme proposed.

complianceAttestations.title: Q1 FY27 tenant-wide compliance attestation
complianceAttestations.attestationStatement: Based on assessments completed during the quarter and exceptions disclosed in the exception register, the compliance function attests that the AMC materially complied with applicable SEBI obligations, except as disclosed for cyber patch SLAs, DR RTO evidence and DPDP readiness.

complianceAttestations.title: NAV obligation attestation — June 2026
complianceAttestations.attestationStatement: All June NAVs were computed, verified and published within prescribed timelines with no reportable errors.

complianceAttestations.title: Q2 FY27 tenant-wide compliance attestation
complianceAttestations.attestationStatement: Draft attestation for the September quarter — pending completion of quarter-end assessments.

calendarEntries.title: Cyber framework VAPT re-test evidence submission

complianceExceptions.title: Cyber patch SLA non-compliance
complianceExceptions.description: Patch management SLA breaches on legacy servers place the cyber framework obligation in partial compliance.
complianceExceptions.remediationPlan: Tracked jointly with control exception CEX-2026-0001; platform upgrade closes root cause by November.

complianceExceptions.title: DPDP readiness gap
complianceExceptions.description: No consent tooling, breach notification runbook or data principal rights workflow; DPDP Rules effective January 2027.
complianceExceptions.remediationPlan: DPDP remediation programme: privacy notice refresh, consent capture in investor onboarding, breach runbook, rights-request workflow.

complianceExceptions.title: Advertising code disclosure omission in June digital campaign
complianceExceptions.description: One social media campaign omitted the standard risk disclosure in story-format creatives; campaign paused and reissued.
complianceExceptions.remediationPlan: Creative templates locked with embedded disclosures; pre-approval checklist extended to story formats.
